registers.name: cfd_ctrl
registers.description: CAN FD control register. Controls the operating mode and the protocol options of the controller.

fields.name: init
fields.description:
Initialization. Stops the protocol engine so that the configuration can be changed; it is also set by the hardware on bus-off, on a clock stop and on a safety stop.

Usage: software clears it after the configuration to start the bus integration; software sets it to stop; bus-off and safety errors set it and software clears it again.

Values:
0x0 the controller takes part in the bus communication (reset value is 1);
0x1 the controller is stopped and its pins are recessive.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cce
fields.description:
Configuration change enable. Opens the protected registers for writing while init is 1.

Usage: software sets it after init is 1 and clears it before it clears init.

Values:
0x0 protected registers are write-protected;
0x1 protected registers can be written when init is 1.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: mon
fields.description:
Bus monitoring mode. The controller receives only and never drives a dominant bit, not even the acknowledge or the error flag.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state.

Values:
0x0 normal operation;
0x1 bus monitoring.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rest
fields.description:
Restricted operation mode. The controller receives and acknowledges frames but does not transmit.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state.

Values:
0x0 normal operation;
0x1 restricted operation.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lbk_int
fields.description:
Internal loopback. The transmit data is fed back to the receiver inside the IP and the bus pin stays recessive.

Usage: software uses it for a self-test; it needs the mon bit set so that the controller stays silent on the bus.

Values:
0x0 no loopback;
0x1 internal loopback.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: lbk_ext
fields.description:
External loopback. The transmit data is fed back to the receiver, the bus pin is driven and the acknowledge comes from the bus.

Usage: software uses it for a test with a transceiver; it is ignored when lbk_int is set.

Values:
0x0 no loopback;
0x1 external loopback.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: fdoe
fields.description:
CAN FD operation enable. Allows the controller to send and receive FD frames; without it an FD frame is a form error.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state and only when fd_en of cfd_feat0 is 1.

Values:
0x0 Classic CAN only;
0x1 FD frames enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: brse
fields.description:
Bit rate switch enable. Allows the data phase of FD frames to use the data bit time of cfd_dbt.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state; it has an effect only when fdoe is 1.

Values:
0x0 the data phase uses the nominal bit time;
0x1 bit rate switching allowed.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: niso
fields.description:
Non-ISO format select. Selects the CAN FD format of the Bosch specification 1.0 of 2012 instead of the ISO 11898-1 format.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state and only when niso_en of cfd_feat0 is 1; all nodes of the network must use the same format.

Values:
0x0 ISO CAN FD;
0x1 non-ISO CAN FD.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: pxd
fields.description:
Protocol exception disable. Selects the reaction to a recessive reserved bit in an FD frame.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state.

Values:
0x0 the receiver enters the protocol exception state and waits for the bus idle;
0x1 a recessive reserved bit is a form error.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: dar
fields.description:
Disable automatic retransmission. A frame that lost arbitration or failed is not sent again (single shot).

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state; the Tx buffer is reported as cancelled after the failure.

Values:
0x0 a failed frame is sent again;
0x1 single shot.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tdc_ena
fields.description:
Transmitter delay compensation enable. Switches on the secondary sample point in the data phase of transmitted FD frames.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state; set it when the data bit time is shorter than the loop delay of the transceiver.

Values:
0x0 the normal sample point is used;
0x1 the secondary sample point is used.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: efbi
fields.description:
Edge filtering during bus integration. Two consecutive dominant time quanta are needed for the hard synchronization while the bus integration runs.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state.

Values:
0x0 no filtering;
0x1 edge filtering.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: sleep_req
fields.description:
Sleep request. Software asks the controller to finish the frame, set init and put the transceiver in standby; hardware clears it when the controller wakes up.

Usage: software sets it to enter sleep; hardware clears it after the wake-up is acknowledged in cfd_wake.

Values:
0x0 no sleep request;
0x1 enter sleep.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: bus_sel
fields.description:
Bus select. Chooses the active bus pair when the redundant bus is built.

Usage: software writes it in the configuration state or while the bus is idle; the change waits for the bus idle.

Values:
0x0 primary bus pair o_can_tx and i_can_rx;
0x1 redundant bus pair o_can_tx_b and i_can_rx_b.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ovl_en
fields.description:
Overload frame enable. When set, the controller sends an overload frame if it cannot take the next frame because all transfer registers between the two clock domains are full; at most two overload frames in a row are sent as the CAN rule requires.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state; leave it 0 for the highest bus throughput (the lost frame is then counted by ovr of cfd_rx_sts).

Values:
0x0 never send an overload frame for an internal condition (reset value);
0x1 send an overload frame when no transfer register is free.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tx_pause
fields.description:
Transmit pause. The controller waits two extra bit times after the intermission before it starts a new transmission.

Usage: software writes it only in the configuration state.

Values:
0x0 no pause;
0x1 two extra bit times of pause.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_nbt
registers.description: CAN FD nominal bit timing register. Configures the common nominal/data prescaler and nominal bit-time segments.

fields.name: nbrp
fields.description:
Common nominal/data prescaler. The stored value is the prescaler minus one; this value also defines the data-phase prescaler.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x1F represent a common prescaler m of 1 to 32 CAN clock periods. Higher codes are clamped to 0x1F and set cfg_fix.

Unit: CAN clock periods.

Limits: The effective data prescaler in dbrp shall equal m.

fields.name: nprop
fields.description:
Nominal propagation segment. The stored value is the segment length in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x000 to 0x17F represent 1 to 384 time quanta. Higher codes are clamped to 0x17F and set cfg_fix.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: Include the system and transceiver propagation delay required by section 10.6.2.

fields.name: nphs1
fields.description:
Nominal PHASE_SEG1. The stored value is the segment length in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x7F represent 1 to 128 time quanta.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: Cross-field timing constraints are checked before INIT can be cleared; invalid tuples keep the controller in INIT and set cfg_fix.

fields.name: nphs2
fields.description:
Nominal PHASE_SEG2. The stored value is the segment length in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x01 to 0x7F represent 2 to 128 time quanta. Code 0 is below the minimum legal value and is clamped to code 1 with cfg_fix.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: Do not clamp PHASE_SEG2 to PHASE_SEG1. Cross-field timing constraints are checked before INIT can be cleared.

registers.name: cfd_nbt2
registers.description: CAN FD bit timing synchronization register. Configures the nominal and FD data-phase resynchronization jump widths.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

fields.name: nsjw
fields.description:
Nominal (arbitration-phase) resynchronization jump width. The stored value is the jump width in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x7F represent 1 to 128 time quanta.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: The effective value shall not exceed the smaller of nominal PHASE_SEG1 and PHASE_SEG2. A violation is a cross-field configuration error; the controller remains in INIT and sets cfg_fix.

fields.name: dsjw
fields.description:
FD data-phase resynchronization jump width. The stored value is the jump width in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x7F represent 1 to 128 time quanta.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: The effective value shall not exceed the smaller of data PHASE_SEG1 and PHASE_SEG2. A violation is a cross-field configuration error; the controller remains in INIT and sets cfg_fix.

registers.name: cfd_dbt
registers.description: CAN FD data bit timing register. Configures the FD data-phase prescaler and segment lengths.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

fields.name: dphs2
fields.description:
FD data-phase PHASE_SEG2. The stored value is the segment length in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x01 to 0x7F represent 2 to 128 time quanta. Code 0 is below the minimum legal value and is clamped to code 1 with cfg_fix.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: Do not clamp PHASE_SEG2 to PHASE_SEG1. Cross-field timing constraints are checked before INIT can be cleared.

fields.name: dphs1
fields.description:
FD data-phase PHASE_SEG1. The stored value is the segment length in time quanta minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x7F represent 1 to 128 time quanta.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: Cross-field timing constraints are checked before INIT can be cleared.

fields.name: dprop
fields.description:
FD data-phase propagation segment in time quanta. This field stores the segment length directly.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x80 represent 0 to 128 time quanta. Higher codes are clamped to 0x80 and set cfg_fix.

Unit: time quanta.

Limits: 0 time quanta is permitted.

fields.name: dbrp
fields.description:
FD data-phase prescaler. The stored value is the prescaler minus one.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x1F represent prescaler m of 1 to 32 CAN clock periods.

Unit: CAN clock periods.

Limits: The effective value shall equal the common prescaler encoded by nbrp; a mismatch is a cross-field configuration error and keeps the controller in INIT with cfg_fix.

registers.name: cfd_tdc
registers.description: CAN FD transmitter delay compensation register. Configures the optional filter window and SSP offset and reports the measured transmitter delay.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

fields.name: tdcv
fields.description:
Measured transmitter delay in minimum time quanta. The measurement is reported directly and is valid after a transmitted FD frame.

Usage: software reads this field to observe measured loop delay.

Values:
0x00 to 0x7F represent 0 to 127 minimum time quanta; the measurement range covers the adopted 95-tq minimum.

Unit: minimum time quanta.

Limits: Read-only.

fields.name: tdcf
fields.description:
TDC filter window: minimum allowed candidate SSP position. When tdcf is greater than tdco, the filter is enabled; dominant RX edges that would yield an SSP candidate earlier than tdcf are ignored during delay measurement. TDCF does not replace or clamp the measured delay.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x00 to 0x7F represent 0 to 127 minimum time quanta.

Unit: minimum time quanta.

Limits: Filter behavior and SSP formation follow section 10.6.9.

fields.name: tdco
fields.description:
TDC secondary sample-point offset in minimum time quanta. The candidate SSP is measured tdcv plus this offset.

Usage: software writes this field only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x01 to 0xA0 represent 1 to 160 minimum time quanta. Values below or above this range are clamped to the nearest legal value and set cfg_fix.

Unit: minimum time quanta.

Limits: The 9-bit internal sum supports the full field combination up to 287 minimum time quanta without wrap; the adopted ISO profile requires support through at least 255 minimum time quanta.

registers.name: cfd_sts
registers.description: CAN FD status register. Shows the live protocol state of the controller.

fields.name: reserved
fields.description:
This field is unused.
Read-as-zero and write-ignored.

fields.name: dom_stk
fields.description:
Bus stuck dominant. Shows that the bus has been dominant for more than dom_lim bit times and has not yet returned to recessive.

Usage: software reads it together with the dom_to interrupt to find a short circuit of the CAN wires or a failed transceiver.

Values:
0x0 bus not stuck;
0x1 bus stuck dominant.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cfg_fix
fields.description:
Configuration correction or rejection. Indicates that a scalar timing value was clamped or an invalid cross-field timing tuple prevented INIT from clearing.

Usage: software reads this flag after attempting to leave INIT, then corrects timing registers.

Values:
0x0 no correction or invalid tuple is pending;
0x1 a timing value was clamped or the tuple is invalid.

Unit: none.

Limits: An invalid cross-field tuple is never silently repaired; the controller remains in INIT until software corrects it.

fields.name: red_act
fields.description:
Redundant bus active. Shows which bus pair is in use.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 primary pair;
0x1 redundant pair.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: wake_pend
fields.description:
Wake-up pending. Shows that o_wake_req is high and waits for the acknowledge.

Usage: software reads it, then writes wake_ack of cfd_wake.

Values:
0x0 no wake-up request;
0x1 wake-up request pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: pxe
fields.description:

0x1 protocol exception.

Unit: none.

fields.name: ep

registers.name: cfd_ecnt
registers.description: CAN FD error counter register. Shows the receive and the transmit error counters.

fields.name: rec
fields.description:
Receive error counter. Counts the errors of the receiver by the fault confinement rules; it saturates at 127.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7F counter value.

Unit: count.

Limits: The value is 0 to 127..

fields.name: tec
fields.description:
Transmit error counter. Counts the errors of the transmitter; above 255 the controller is bus-off.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 to 0x100 counter value.

Unit: count.

Limits: The value is 0 to 256..

fields.name: rp
fields.description:
Receive error passive. Shows that the receive error counter has reached the passive limit of 128.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

0x0 below the limit;
0x1 at or above the limit.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_wake
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up control register. Controls the transceiver and the wake-up request.

fields.name: wake_ack
fields.description:
Wake-up acknowledge. Software confirms that it has seen the wake-up request; hardware then drops o_wake_req and clears this bit.

Usage: software writes 1 after it has read wake_pend of cfd_sts.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 acknowledge the wake-up request.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: wake_bus
fields.description:
Wake-up by bus activity. A dominant bit on the bus wakes the controller when partial networking is off.

Usage: software writes it before it requests sleep.

Values:
0x0 no wake-up by a dominant bit;
0x1 wake-up by a dominant bit.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: trcv_on
fields.description:
Transceiver enable request. Drives o_trcv_en high when the controller is not asleep.

Usage: software sets it before it clears init.

Values:
0x0 transceiver in standby;
0x1 transceiver in normal mode.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: trcv_auto
fields.description:
Automatic transceiver control. The controller drives o_trcv_en from its own state: high when init is 0 and low in sleep.

Usage: software sets it instead of controlling trcv_on by hand.

Values:
0x0 trcv_on decides;
0x1 the controller state decides.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: wup_len
fields.description:
Wake-up pattern length. The shortest dominant level on the bus, in units of 8 CAN clock periods, that counts as a wake-up by bus activity; a shorter dominant level is a glitch and is ignored.

Usage: software writes it before it requests sleep; it applies to wake_bus only.

Values:
0x00 any dominant sample point wakes the controller;
0x01 to 0xFF number of 8 CAN clock periods.

Unit: 8 CAN clock periods.

Limits: The value is 0 to 255, so up to 2040 CAN clock periods..

fields.name: trcv_dly
fields.description:
Transceiver start-up delay. The time that the controller waits after it raised o_trcv_en before it takes part in the bus integration, in units of 64 CAN clock periods; it covers the wake-up time of the transceiver.

Usage: software writes it before the first sleep; the delay runs after trcv_on or the automatic transceiver control has raised o_trcv_en.

Values:
0x0000 no delay;
0x0001 to 0xFFFF number of 64 CAN clock periods.

Unit: 64 CAN clock periods.

Limits: The value is 0 to 65535..

registers.description: CAN FD Rx buffer new data register 0. Shows which dedicated Rx buffers hold a new message.

fields.name: newd
fields.description:
New data flags of the dedicated Rx buffers 0 to 31. A bit is set by the controller when it has written a message in the buffer.

Usage: software reads the buffer when its bit is set and writes 1 to the bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 no new data;
0x1 new data (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above the number of buffers stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_rxb_nd1
registers.description: CAN FD Rx buffer new data register 1. Shows which dedicated Rx buffers hold a new message.

fields.name: newd
fields.description:
New data flags of the dedicated Rx buffers 32 to 63. A bit is set by the controller when it has written a message in the buffer.

Usage: software reads the buffer when its bit is set and writes 1 to the bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 no new data;
0x1 new data (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above the number of buffers stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_txb_req
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer request register. Software requests the transmission of Tx buffers.

fields.name: req
fields.description:
Tx buffer add request. Writing 1 to bit n requests the transmission of Tx buffer n; the controller clears the bit when the frame is sent or cancelled.

Usage: software fills the buffer element first, then sets the bit; it must not change the element while the bit is 1.

Values:
0x0 no request or finished;
0x1 transmission requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_txb_cancel
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer cancel register. Software cancels pending Tx buffer requests.

fields.name: creq
fields.description:
Tx buffer cancellation request. Writing 1 to bit n asks the controller to cancel the pending request of buffer n; the bit is cleared when the cancellation is done.

Usage: software sets it for a buffer whose request is no longer wanted; the result is in cfd_txb_cdone and cfd_txb_done.

Values:
0x0 no cancellation;
0x1 cancel the request.

Unit: none.

Limits: A frame that has already started is sent to the end..

registers.name: cfd_txb_done
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer transmission done register. Shows which Tx buffers were sent.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Transmission done flags. Bit n is set by the controller when Tx buffer n was transmitted successfully.

Usage: software reads it after the Tx complete interrupt and writes 1 to the bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not sent;
0x1 sent (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_txb_cdone
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer cancellation done register. Shows which Tx buffers were cancelled.

fields.name: cdn
fields.description:
Cancellation finished flags. Bit n is set by the controller when the request of Tx buffer n was cancelled before the frame started.

Usage: software reads it after the Tx cancelled interrupt and writes 1 to the bit to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not cancelled;
0x1 cancelled (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_txb_ie
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer done interrupt enable register. Selects which Tx buffers raise the Tx complete event.

fields.name: done_ie
fields.description:
Transmission done interrupt enable. Bit n lets the transmission of Tx buffer n set the tx_done event.

Usage: software sets it for the buffers it wants to be told about.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 have no effect..

registers.name: cfd_txb_cie
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer cancellation interrupt enable register. Selects which Tx buffers raise the Tx cancelled event.

fields.name: canc_ie
fields.description:
Cancellation interrupt enable. Bit n lets the cancellation of Tx buffer n set the tx_can event.

Usage: software sets it for the buffers it wants to be told about.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 have no effect..

registers.name: cfd_txb_trtx
registers.description: CAN FD trigger transmit confirm register. Software confirms the data of trigger-transmit buffers.

fields.name: conf
fields.description:
Trigger transmit data confirm. Writing 1 to bit n tells the controller that the data of trigger-transmit buffer n is ready; the controller clears the bit when it has taken it.

Usage: software writes the element and then sets the bit after the data request of cfd_txb_dreq.

Values:
0x0 no confirmation;
0x1 data is ready.

Unit: none.

Limits: It has an effect only when trtx_en of cfd_feat0 is 1..

registers.name: cfd_txb_dreq
registers.description: CAN FD trigger transmit data request register. Shows which trigger-transmit buffers wait for data.

fields.name: data_req
fields.description:
Trigger transmit data request flags. Bit n is 1 while buffer n is the next to transmit and waits for the data.

Usage: software polls it and prepares the element, then writes cfd_txb_trtx.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 data requested.

Unit: none.

Limits: It has an effect only when trtx_en of cfd_feat0 is 1..

registers.name: cfd_txr_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD Tx retransmission register. Sets the default number of retransmissions of a failed frame.

fields.name: retry_max
fields.description:
Global retransmission limit. The number of retransmissions that are allowed after a failed attempt (an error or a lost arbitration) for a buffer whose element has RTL = 0; when the failed attempts exceed it, the buffer is cancelled and reported as failed.

Usage: software writes it before it requests transmissions; it applies to the frame that is in transmission and its counter restarts when another buffer is selected.

Values:
0x00 unlimited retransmissions (CAN rule, reset value);
0x01 to 0xFF number of retransmissions.

Unit: retransmissions.

Limits: The global bit dar of cfd_ctrl (single shot) has priority over this value..

registers.name: cfd_txb_fail
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer failed register. Shows which Tx buffers were cancelled because the retransmission limit was reached.

fields.name: fail
fields.description:
Retransmission limit reached flags. Bit n is set by the controller when the request of Tx buffer n was cancelled because the failed attempts exceeded retry_max of cfd_txr_cfg.

Usage: software reads it after the Tx cancelled interrupt, together with cfd_txb_cdone, and writes 1 to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not failed;
0x1 retransmission limit reached (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_txp_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD Tx priority register. Selects how the Tx buffers are ordered and enables the express buffer.

fields.name: prio_mode
fields.description:
Priority mode. Selects what decides which pending Tx buffer is sent first.

Usage: software writes it while no Tx request is pending.

Values:
0x0 by identifier: the lowest identifier (extension bit last) is sent first;
0x1 fixed priority: the PRIO field of the Tx element decides (0 is the highest), the identifier is ignored.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: exp_en
fields.description:
Express buffer enable. Tx buffer 0 is always sent before every other buffer, whatever the priority mode, for urgent frames.

Usage: software clears it when buffer 0 must be an ordinary buffer or when the BUS clock is too low for the express fetch (section 10.12.5); it needs ded_num of cfd_txb_cfg of at least 1.

Values:
0x0 buffer 0 is an ordinary buffer;
0x1 buffer 0 is the express buffer (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_txf_sts
registers.description: CAN FD Tx FIFO status register. Shows the state of the Tx FIFO part of the Tx buffers.

fields.name: free
fields.description:
Tx FIFO free level. Number of free Tx buffers of the FIFO part.

Usage: software reads it before it adds a message to the FIFO.

Values:
0x0 to 0x20 free buffers.

Unit: buffers.

Limits: The value is 0 to 32..

fields.name: gidx
fields.description:
Tx FIFO get index. The buffer that is sent next.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1F index.

Unit: buffers.

Limits: The value is below fifo_num of cfd_txb_cfg..

fields.name: pidx
fields.description:
Tx FIFO put index. The buffer that software fills next.

Usage: software writes the next message at this index.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1F index.

Unit: buffers.

Limits: The value is below fifo_num of cfd_txb_cfg..

fields.name: full
fields.description:
Tx FIFO full. No free buffer is left in the FIFO part.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 space left;
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_txe_sts
registers.description: CAN FD Tx event FIFO status register. Shows the indexes and the fill level of the Tx event FIFO.

fields.name: fill
fields.description:
Tx event FIFO fill level. Number of events that wait for software.

Usage: software polls it or uses the watermark event.

Values:
0x0 to 0x20 events.

Unit: elements.

Limits: The value is 0 to 32..

fields.name: gidx
fields.description:
Tx event FIFO get index. The event element that software reads next.

Usage: software reads the element at this index and then writes it to ack_idx of cfd_txe_ack.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1F index.

Unit: elements.

Limits: The value is below the FIFO size..

fields.name: pidx
fields.description:
Tx event FIFO put index. The event element that the controller writes next.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1F index.

Unit: elements.

Limits: The value is below the FIFO size..

fields.name: full
fields.description:
Tx event FIFO full. The FIFO holds as many events as its size.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 space left;
0x1 full.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_txe_ack
registers.description: CAN FD Tx event acknowledge register. Tells the controller which events software has read.

fields.name: ack_idx
fields.description:
Tx event acknowledge index. The index of the last event element that software has read.

Usage: software writes it and then sets ack_go.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1F index.

Unit: elements.

Limits: The value is below the FIFO size..

fields.name: ack_go
fields.description:
Tx event acknowledge command. Hardware sets the get index to ack_idx plus one and clears this bit.

Usage: software writes 1 after ack_idx; it reads 0 when the controller has taken the value.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 acknowledge the events up to ack_idx.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_ts_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD timestamp configuration register. Selects the time source and the prescaler of the timestamp.

fields.name: ts_sel
ts_pres
fields.description:
Timestamp prescaler. The counter counts once per prescaler value plus one CAN clock periods.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF prescaler minus one.

Unit: CAN clock periods.

Limits: The value plus one is 1 to 16..

registers.name: cfd_ts_cnt
registers.description: CAN FD timestamp counter register. Shows the running timestamp counter.

fields.name: ts_val
fields.description:
Timestamp counter value. The value of the free-running counter; with a 16-bit counter only the low half is used.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain; the value is not coherent with a frame timestamp.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF counter value.

Unit: timestamp ticks.

Limits: The counter wraps around..

registers.name: cfd_tout_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD timeout counter configuration register. Sets the mode and the period of the timeout counter.

fields.name: tout_on
fields.description:
Timeout counter enable. Switches the counter on.

Usage: software writes it after it has set the period.

Values:
0x0 counter off;
0x1 counter on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tout_sel
tout_per
fields.description:
Timeout period. The start value of the down-counter.

Usage: software writes it with the counter off.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF period.

Unit: timeout ticks.

Limits: The value 0 is treated as 1..

registers.name: cfd_tout_cnt
registers.description: CAN FD timeout counter register. Shows the running timeout counter.

fields.name: tout_val
fields.description:
Timeout counter value. The present value of the down-counter.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF counter value.

Unit: timeout ticks.

Limits: The counter stops at 0..

registers.name: cfd_dma_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD DMA configuration register. Enables the DMA request outputs, selects single or burst service and sets the flush timeout.

fields.name: rx0_dma
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 0 DMA request enable. Lets Rx FIFO 0 raise o_dma_req_rx0.

Usage: software sets it after it has programmed the DMA engine.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx1_dma
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 1 DMA request enable. Lets Rx FIFO 1 raise o_dma_req_rx1.

Usage: software sets it after it has programmed the DMA engine.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tx_dma
fields.description:
Tx DMA request enable. Lets a free Tx FIFO buffer raise o_dma_req_tx.

Usage: software sets it after it has programmed the DMA engine.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txe_dma
fields.description:
Tx event DMA request enable. Lets the Tx event FIFO raise o_dma_req_txe; it needs txevt_en of cfd_feat0.

Usage: software sets it after it has programmed the DMA engine.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx0_burst
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 0 service type. Selects what one request of o_dma_req_rx0 stands for.

Usage: software writes it before it enables the request.

Values:
0x0 single: a request for every message in the FIFO;
0x1 burst: a request when the fill level reaches the watermark wm of cfd_rxf0_cfg.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx1_burst
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 1 service type. Selects what one request of o_dma_req_rx1 stands for.

Usage: software writes it before it enables the request.

Values:
0x0 single: a request for every message in the FIFO;
0x1 burst: a request when the fill level reaches the watermark wm of cfd_rxf1_cfg.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txe_burst
fields.description:
Tx event FIFO service type. Selects what one request of o_dma_req_txe stands for.

Usage: software writes it before it enables the request.

Values:
0x0 single: a request for every event in the FIFO;
0x1 burst: a request when the fill level reaches the watermark wm of cfd_txe_cfg.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: dma_to
fields.description:
Flush timeout. In the burst service, the time after which the request rises for the messages that wait below the watermark; it counts from the arrival of the oldest unserved message and restarts after a service.

Usage: software writes it before it enables a burst request; the DMA engine reads the fill level to learn how many messages wait.

Values:
0x0000 no flush, messages below the watermark wait;
0x0001 to 0xFFFF number of 64 BUS clock periods.

Unit: 64 BUS clock periods.

Limits: The timeout applies to the three burst FIFOs; it has no effect in the single service..

registers.name: cfd_dma_sts
registers.description: CAN FD DMA status register. Shows the DMA requests that are pending.

fields.name: rx0_req
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 0 DMA request pending. The output o_dma_req_rx0 is high.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx1_req
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 1 DMA request pending. The output o_dma_req_rx1 is high.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tx_req
fields.description:
Tx DMA request pending. The output o_dma_req_tx is high.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txe_req
fields.description:
Tx event DMA request pending. The output o_dma_req_txe is high.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 no request;
0x1 request pending.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx0_fl
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 0 flush request. The pending request was caused by the flush timeout, not by the watermark.

Usage: the DMA engine reads it, then reads the fill level for the number of messages.

Values:
0x0 normal request;
0x1 flush request.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: rx1_fl
fields.description:
Rx FIFO 1 flush request. The pending request was caused by the flush timeout, not by the watermark.

Usage: the DMA engine reads it, then reads the fill level for the number of messages.

Values:
0x0 normal request;
0x1 flush request.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txe_fl
fields.description:
Tx event FIFO flush request. The pending request was caused by the flush timeout, not by the watermark.

Usage: the DMA engine reads it, then reads the fill level for the number of events.

Values:
0x0 normal request;
0x1 flush request.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_hpm_sts
registers.description: CAN FD high priority message status register. Shows where the last high priority message was stored.

fields.name: hp_fidx
fields.description:
Filter index of the high priority message. The index of the filter element that matched the last message with a high priority action.

Usage: software reads it in the high priority interrupt service routine, before it reads the message.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7F filter element index.

Unit: elements.

Limits: The value is 0 to 127 for standard and 0 to 63 for extended filters..

fields.name: hp_fifo
fields.description:
FIFO of the high priority message. Shows the Rx FIFO that holds the last high priority message.

Usage: software reads it together with hp_idx.

Values:
0x0 Rx FIFO 0;
0x1 Rx FIFO 1.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: hp_idx
fields.description:
Element index of the high priority message. The position of the message in its Rx FIFO.

Usage: software reads the element at this index without waiting for the older messages.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3F element index.

Unit: elements.

Limits: The value is below the FIFO size..

fields.name: hp_vld
fields.description:
High priority message valid. Set by the hardware when a high priority message was stored; the other fields of this register are valid while it is 1.

Usage: software writes 1 to clear it after it has read the fields.

Values:
0x0 no unread high priority message;
0x1 high priority message stored (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_rx_sts
registers.description: CAN FD receive path status register. Shows losses before the filter and the load of the filter.

fields.name: ovr
fields.description:
Handoff overrun. A received frame was lost before the filter because all transfer registers between the two clock domains were full.

Usage: software reads it after a burst of frames, clears it by writing 1 and then checks the message RAM speed and PARA_CANFD_RXHOLD_NUM (section 10.11).

Values:
0x0 no frame lost in the handoff;
0x1 a frame was lost (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: flt_busy
fields.description:
Filter busy. The Rx handler is filtering or storing a frame.

Usage: software may read it before it starts a soft reset.

Values:
0x0 handler idle;
0x1 handler busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: flt_peak
fields.description:
Peak handling time. The longest time from the start of the filter to the end of the store since the last reset, in BUS clocks, saturating at the maximum.

Usage: software reads it to check the margin of the message RAM speed against the frame time (section 10.11.5).

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF BUS clocks.

Unit: BUS clock periods.

Limits: The value saturates at 0xFFFF..

registers.name: cfd_dom_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD dominant timeout register. Sets the length of a dominant bus level that is reported as a fault.

fields.name: dom_lim
fields.description:
Dominant timeout limit. The number of consecutive dominant bit times at the sample point after which the bus is reported as stuck dominant (flag dom_stk of cfd_sts and the interrupt dom_to).

Usage: software writes it at any time; the controller does not change its transmit behavior when the flag is set.

Values:
0x00 detection off;
0x01 to 0x0F treated as 0x10;
0x10 to 0xFF number of bit times (reset value 0x20 = 32).

Unit: bit times.

Limits: A legal frame has at most 14 consecutive dominant bits (6 flag bits, the superposed flags and the delimiter wait), so values below 16 are raised to 16..

registers.name: cfd_wksrc
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up source register. Shows what woke the controller and whether a sleep request was refused.

fields.name: src_bus
fields.description:
Wake-up by bus activity. A dominant level of at least wup_len woke the controller.

Usage: software reads it after the wake interrupt and writes 1 to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not the source;
0x1 the source (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: src_trcv
fields.description:
Wake-up by the transceiver. The input i_trcv_wake woke the controller.

Usage: software reads it after the wake interrupt and writes 1 to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not the source;
0x1 the source (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: src_wuf
fields.description:
Wake-up by a wake-up frame. A frame that matched a filter of the partial networking woke the controller.

Usage: software reads it with wuf_idx after the wake interrupt and writes 1 to clear it.

Values:
0x0 not the source;
0x1 the source (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: wuf_idx
fields.description:
Matching filter. The index of the wake-up frame filter that matched; valid while src_wuf is 1.

Usage: software reads it to find which message pattern woke the node.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7 filter index.

Unit: none.

Limits: The value is below pn_num of cfd_feat1..

fields.name: slp_blk
fields.description:
Sleep refused. A sleep request was refused because a Tx request was pending.

Usage: software cancels the pending requests, clears the flag by writing 1 and asks for sleep again.

Values:
0x0 no refusal;
0x1 a sleep request was refused (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pn_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD partial networking configuration register. Switches the wake-up frame filter on.

fields.name: pn_on
fields.description:
Partial networking enable. The wake-up frame filters are used during sleep instead of a wake-up by any dominant bit.

Usage: software sets it before it requests sleep, after the filters are programmed.

Values:
0x0 wake-up by a dominant bit if wake_bus is set;
0x1 wake-up only by a matching frame.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: pn_err_ign
fields.description:
Ignore frames with errors. A frame with an error is never a wake-up frame; this bit also ignores the bus errors counted during sleep.

Usage: software sets it as the ISO 11898-2 style of wake-up requires.

Values:
0x0 frames with errors are only skipped;
0x1 frames with errors are ignored and do not change the counters.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pnf_id
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame identifier register. Holds the identifier that a wake-up frame must have.

fields.name: pnf_id
fields.description:
Wake-up frame identifier. The identifier that is compared with the received identifier through the mask of cfd_pnf_idm.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1FFFFFFF identifier.

Unit: none.

Limits: A base identifier uses bits 28 to 18..

fields.name: pnf_xtd
fields.description:
Wake-up frame extended format. Selects the identifier format that the filter matches.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 base format;
0x1 extended format.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: pnf_on
fields.description:
Wake-up filter enable. Switches this filter on.

Usage: software sets it after it has programmed the filter registers.

Values:
0x0 filter off;
0x1 filter on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pnf_idm
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame identifier mask register. Selects the identifier bits that are compared.

fields.name: pnf_idm
fields.description:
Wake-up frame identifier mask. A 1 in a bit position means that this identifier bit must match.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1FFFFFFF mask.

Unit: none.

Limits: The value uses 29 bits..

registers.name: cfd_pnf_dlc
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame length register. Sets the data length that a wake-up frame must have.

fields.name: pnf_dlc
fields.description:
Wake-up frame data length code. The DLC that is compared with the received DLC when the check is on.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 to 0xF DLC.

Unit: none.

Limits: The value is 0 to 15..

fields.name: pnf_dlc_en
fields.description:
Wake-up frame DLC check enable. Switches the DLC comparison on.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 the length is not compared;
0x1 the length must equal pnf_dlc.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pnf_d0
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame data register 0. Holds data bytes 0 to 3 of the wake-up frame.

fields.name: pnf_d0
fields.description:
Wake-up frame data bytes 0 to 3. Byte 0 is in bits 7 to 0.

Usage: software writes it before sleep and may change it at run time (REQ-PN-001).

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF data.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pnf_d1
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame data register 1. Holds data bytes 4 to 7 of the wake-up frame.

fields.name: pnf_d1
fields.description:
Wake-up frame data bytes 4 to 7. Byte 4 is in bits 7 to 0.

Usage: software writes it before sleep and may change it at run time (REQ-PN-001).

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF data.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pnf_dm0
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame data mask register 0. Selects the bits of data bytes 0 to 3 that are compared.

fields.name: pnf_dm0
fields.description:
Wake-up frame data mask for bytes 0 to 3. A 1 means that the bit must match.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF mask.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_pnf_dm1
registers.description: CAN FD wake-up frame data mask register 1. Selects the bits of data bytes 4 to 7 that are compared.

fields.name: pnf_dm1
fields.description:
Wake-up frame data mask for bytes 4 to 7. A 1 means that the bit must match.

Usage: software writes it before sleep.

Values:
0x0 to 0xFFFFFFFF mask.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_tt_cfg
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN configuration register. Sets the operation mode, the master role and the matrix length.

fields.name: tt_mode
tm_en
fields.description:
Potential time master. The node may send the reference message.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x0 the node is a time slave;
0x1 the node is a potential time master.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tm_prio
fields.description:
Time master priority. The 3 low bits of the reference message identifier; the lowest value is the highest priority; two potential masters must not use the same value.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7 priority.

Unit: none.

Limits: The value is 0 to 7..

fields.name: l2_sel
fields.description:
Level 2 select. The node operates in TTCAN level 2 (global time and drift compensation); all potential masters of a network use the same level.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; it needs tt_l2_en of cfd_feat0.

Values:
0x0 level 1;
0x1 level 2.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: eecs
fields.description:
External clock synchronisation enable. The current time master may adjust the NTU length and the global time phase during operation (cfd_tt_clk, cfd_tt_gpre).

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; it needs the option PARA_CANFD_TT_EXTSYNC_EN and l2_sel.

Values:
0x0 not allowed;
0x1 allowed.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ccm
fields.description:
Last basic cycle of the matrix. The cycle count at which the matrix cycle ends and the count restarts at zero; a time slave takes the count from the reference message.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x00 matrix of one basic cycle;
0x01 to 0x3F number of the last basic cycle.

Unit: basic cycles.

Limits: The value plus one should be a power of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64)..

fields.name: refo
fields.description:
Initial reference trigger offset. The number of NTU after which a backup time master starts the reference message when a reference message is expected and the bus stays idle; the recommended value is the master priority multiplied by a factor that covers the clock drift of the potential masters.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x00 use the master priority multiplied by 4 (default rule);
0x01 to 0x7F offset.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: The order of the backup masters must follow their priorities even at the largest clock drift..

registers.name: cfd_tt_ref
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN reference message register. Sets the identifier of the reference message.

fields.name: ref_id
fields.description:
Reference message identifier. The identifier without the 3 low priority bits, which the time master takes from tm_prio; a base identifier uses bits 28 to 18.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x0 to 0x1FFFFFFF identifier.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ref_xtd
fields.description:
Reference message extended format. Selects the identifier format of the reference message.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x0 base format;
0x1 extended format.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_tt_turn
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN time unit ratio numerator register. Sets the numerator of the ratio of the network time unit to the CAN clock period.

fields.name: numcfg
fields.description:
TUR numerator. The numerator NumCfg is 0x10000 plus this value (bit 16 is fixed to 1); NumCfg divided by DenomCfg is the number of CAN clock periods in one network time unit, with fractions.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; choose the largest suitable values for the best accuracy; after the configuration it changes only with ecs of cfd_tt_clk.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF numerator minus 0x10000.

Unit: none.

Limits: NumCfg is at least 4 times DenomCfg for level 1 and at least 8 times for level 2..

registers.name: cfd_tt_turd
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN time unit ratio denominator register. Sets the denominator of the ratio and the synchronisation deviation limit.

fields.name: denom
fields.description:
TUR denominator. The denominator DenomCfg of the time unit ratio.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x0001 to 0x3FFF denominator (reset value 0x1000: one NTU is 16 CAN clock periods with the reset value of numcfg).

Unit: none.

Limits: The value 0 is illegal and is treated as 1..

fields.name: ldsdl
fields.description:
Synchronisation deviation limit. The dual logarithm of the limit SDL = 2 to the power of (ldsdl + 5) for the correction of NumAct in level 2.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; it should not exceed the clock tolerance of the CAN bit timing.

Values:
0x0 to 0x7 ld SDL minus 5, so SDL is 32 to 4096.

Unit: none.

Limits: The value is 0 to 7..

registers.name: cfd_tt_mtx
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN matrix limits register. Sets the number of expected Tx triggers, the reference message length and the Tx_Enable window.

fields.name: ett
fields.description:
Expected Tx triggers. The number of Tx triggers (exclusive, arbitrating and merged windows, without reference triggers) that must become active in one matrix cycle; a wrong value raises txu or txo.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; count the cycle codes of the triggers (section 10.13.4).

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF number of triggers.

Unit: triggers.

Limits: The value is 0 to 255..

fields.name: rdlc
fields.description:
Reference message data length code. The DLC of the reference messages that a potential master sends.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x1 to 0x8 length, at least 1 for level 1 and 4 for level 2.

Unit: DLC.

Limits: The value is at most 8 (Classic frames only)..

fields.name: tew
fields.description:
Tx_Enable window. The length in NTU of the period at the start of a time window in which a transmission may start.

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; choose it from the synchronisation quality and the message length.

Values:
0x00 to 0xFF length.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: A message that cannot start inside the window is not sent in this time window..

registers.name: cfd_tt_wd
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN application watchdog register. Sets the limit of the application watchdog.

fields.name: appwd_lim
fields.description:
Application watchdog limit. The largest time between two services of the watchdog, in units of 256 NTU; when it expires all CAN communication stops (interrupt apw).

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration.

Values:
0x00 watchdog off (development only);
0x01 to 0xFF number of 256 NTU.

Unit: 256 NTU.

Limits: The value 0 is for software development only..

fields.name: kick
fields.description:
Application watchdog service. Software writes 1 to restart the watchdog; the hardware clears the bit.

Usage: software writes it at least once in each watchdog period.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 restart the watchdog.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_tt_sts
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN status register. Shows the synchronization and master state and the error level.

fields.name: sync_st
master_st
cyc_cnt
fields.description:
Cycle count. The number of the present basic cycle in the system matrix.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 to 0x3F cycle count.

Unit: basic cycles.

Limits: The value is not above ccm for a master..

fields.name: tt_fail
fields.description:
TTCAN failed. A fatal error (error level 3) stopped the node; it is in bus monitoring mode.

Usage: software restarts in the TT configuration mode.

Values:
0x0 no fatal error;
0x1 fatal error.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ttel

registers.name: cfd_tt_ctime
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN cycle time register. Shows the time inside the basic cycle.

fields.name: cyc_time
fields.description:
Cycle time. The time since the start of the basic cycle in NTU; it restarts at each valid reference message.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF cycle time.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: It cannot be below the length of the reference message in NTU, except at the start..

registers.name: cfd_tt_gtime
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN global time register. Shows the global time of level 2.

fields.name: glob_time
fields.description:
Global time. The local time plus the local offset to the global time of the time master, low-pass filtered except after a discontinuity.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF global time.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: It is valid only in level 2 and when qgtp of cfd_tt_clk is 1..

registers.name: cfd_tt_ltime
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN local time register. Shows the free-running local time.

fields.name: loc_time
fields.description:
Local time. The free-running time of the node in NTU (integer part; the 3-bit fraction is not readable).

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF local time.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: The counter wraps around..

registers.name: cfd_tt_swt
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN stop-watch capture register. Holds the time captured by the stop-watch trigger.

fields.name: swt_time
fields.description:
Stop-watch capture. The local, cycle or global time (sws of cfd_tt_clk) at the last rising edge of i_tt_swatch_trig.

Usage: software reads it after the swe interrupt; the next capture waits until swe is cleared.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF captured time.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_tt_tmark
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN time mark register. Sets the time of the time-mark interrupt.

fields.name: tmark
fields.description:
Time mark. The time at which the interrupt tmi is raised; it is also the time at which a gap ends when tmg of cfd_tt_gap is set.

Usage: software writes it at any time.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF time mark.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tm_src

registers.name: cfd_tt_clk
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN clock control register. Selects the stop-watch source and applies external clock synchronisation.

fields.name: sws
ecs
fields.description:
External clock synchronisation command. A new numcfg of cfd_tt_turn takes effect; hardware clears the bit.

Usage: software writes the new numcfg first and then 1 here; only the current time master with eecs set.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 apply the new time unit ratio.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: sgt
fields.description:
Set global time command. The value of cfd_tt_gpre becomes the global time phase; the next reference message carries the Disc bit.

Usage: software writes cfd_tt_gpre first and then 1 here; only the current time master with eecs set.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 apply the global time preset.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: qcs
fields.description:
Quality of the clock synchronisation. Shows that the automatic drift compensation is active.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 compensation suspended (always 1 in level 1);
0x1 compensation active.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: qgtp
fields.description:
Quality of the global time phase. Shows that the global time is in phase with the master.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 not in phase (always 0 in level 1);
0x1 in phase.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_tt_gpre
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN global time preset register. Holds the new global time phase of the time master.

fields.name: gt_pre
fields.description:
Global time preset. The value that sgt of cfd_tt_clk loads into the global time of the time master.

Usage: software writes it before it sets sgt.

Values:
0x0000 to 0xFFFF preset.

Unit: NTU.

Limits: It needs the option PARA_CANFD_TT_EXTSYNC_EN..

registers.name: cfd_tt_gap
registers.description: CAN FD TTCAN gap control register. Starts and ends gaps in the event-synchronised mode.

fields.name: nig
fields.description:
Next is gap. The time master sends Next_is_Gap = 1 in the next reference message; hardware clears the bit when it has been sent.

Usage: software writes 1 to start a gap after the next basic cycle.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 start a gap.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: fgp
fields.description:
Finish gap. A time master in the state in gap restarts the schedule with a reference message; hardware clears the bit.

Usage: software writes 1 to end a gap.

Values:
0x0 no action;
0x1 finish the gap.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tmg
fields.description:
Time mark gap end. The gap ends when the time reaches tmark of cfd_tt_tmark.

Usage: software sets it while the node is in a gap.

Values:
0x0 not used;
0x1 the time mark ends the gap.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: epe
fields.description:
Event pin enable. The level of i_tt_evt_trig controls the gap: high at the start of a reference message sends Next_is_Gap = 1, low ends a gap.

Usage: software writes it in the TT configuration.

Values:
0x0 pin not used;
0x1 pin used.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: in_gap
fields.description:
In gap. Shows that the node is in a gap of the event-synchronised mode, a period without transmissions.

Usage: software reads it; hardware updates it, the value is a snapshot from the CAN domain.

Values:
0x0 not in a gap;
0x1 in a gap.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_ttb_per
registers.description: CAN FD periodic Tx buffer register. Marks the Tx buffers that carry periodic messages.

fields.name: per
fields.description:
Periodic Tx buffers. Bit n = 1 makes Tx buffer n a periodic buffer: its request stays set and the buffer is sent at every active Tx trigger that points to it, without a new request; bit n = 0 is an event buffer (sent once per request in an arbitrating window).

Usage: software writes it only while INIT = 1 and CCE = 1; a write in another state is ignored; the TT registers are copied to the CAN domain with the configuration; software must keep the data of a periodic buffer valid before the time-triggered operation starts.

Values:
0x0 event buffer;
0x1 periodic buffer.

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_ttb_miss
registers.description: CAN FD Tx buffer missed register. Shows the Tx buffers whose time-triggered transmission did not happen.

fields.name: miss
fields.description:
Tx buffer missed flags. Bit n is set when a Tx trigger of buffer n became active and the message was not sent (the Tx_Enable window passed, the bus was busy, or the transmission failed).

Usage: software reads it after a txu interrupt and writes 1 to clear the bits.

Values:
0x0 no miss;
0x1 missed (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above txbuf_max of cfd_feat1 stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_ttr_miss0
registers.description: CAN FD Rx buffer missed register 0. Shows the dedicated Rx buffers whose periodic message did not arrive.

fields.name: miss
fields.description:
Rx buffer missed flags 0 to 31. Bit n is set when an Rx trigger that points to dedicated Rx buffer 0 became active and the new-data flag of the buffer was not set since the last matrix cycle.

Usage: software reads it after a periodic message is late and writes 1 to clear the bits.

Values:
0x0 message arrived;
0x1 message missing (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above the number of Rx buffers stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_ttr_miss1
registers.description: CAN FD Rx buffer missed register 1. Shows the dedicated Rx buffers whose periodic message did not arrive.

fields.name: miss
fields.description:
Rx buffer missed flags 32 to 63. Bit n is set when an Rx trigger that points to dedicated Rx buffer 32 became active and the new-data flag of the buffer was not set since the last matrix cycle.

Usage: software reads it after a periodic message is late and writes 1 to clear the bits.

Values:
0x0 message arrived;
0x1 message missing (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: Bits above the number of Rx buffers stay 0..

registers.name: cfd_ttirq_raw
registers.description: CAN FD TT raw interrupt register. Holds the sticky TTCAN events.

fields.name: cfe
fields.description:
Configuration error event. Set by the hardware when an error was found in the trigger list.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: apw
fields.description:
Application watchdog event. Set by the hardware when the application watchdog was not served in time.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: wtr
fields.description:
Watch trigger event. Set by the hardware when a watch trigger became active without a reference message.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: iwt
fields.description:
Initial watch trigger event. Set by the hardware when no reference message was seen after the start.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cel
fields.description:
Change of error level event. Set by the hardware when the TT error level changed.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txo
fields.description:
Tx count overflow event. Set by the hardware when more Tx triggers than ett became active in a matrix cycle.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txu
fields.description:
Tx count underflow event. Set by the hardware when fewer Tx triggers than ett became active in a matrix cycle.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: gte
fields.description:
Global time error event. Set by the hardware when the synchronisation deviation exceeded SDL (level 2).

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: dis
fields.description:
Global time discontinuity event. Set by the hardware when a reference message with the Disc bit became valid.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: gtw
fields.description:
Global time wrap event. Set by the hardware when the global time wrapped from 0xFFFF to 0x0000.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: swe
fields.description:
Stop-watch event event. Set by the hardware when a rising edge was captured at i_tt_swatch_trig.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: tmi
fields.description:
Time mark interrupt event. Set by the hardware when the selected time equals the time mark.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: gap
fields.description:
Start of gap event. Set by the hardware when a reference message with Next_is_Gap = 1 was seen.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: csm
fields.description:
Change of synchronisation mode event. Set by the hardware when the master relation or the schedule synchronisation changed.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ssm
fields.description:
Start of system matrix cycle event. Set by the hardware when a new matrix cycle started.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: sbc
fields.description:
Start of basic cycle event. Set by the hardware when a new basic cycle started.

Usage: software reads cfd_ttirq_sts, serves the cause and writes 1 to clear it; a new event in the same cycle keeps the bit set.

Values:
0x0 no event;
0x1 event happened (write 1 to clear).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_ttirq_en

fields.name: apw
fields.description:
Application watchdog interrupt enable. Lets the raw event reach the summary flags tt_mark or tt_err of cfd_irq_raw.

Values:
0x0 event is masked;
0x1 event is enabled.

Limits: none.

fields.name: wtr
fields.description:
Watch trigger interrupt enable. Lets the raw event reach the summary flags tt_mark or tt_err of cfd_irq_raw.

Values:
0x0 event is masked;
0x1 event is enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: iwt
fields.description:
Initial watch trigger interrupt enable. Lets the raw event reach the summary flags tt_mark or tt_err of cfd_irq_raw.

Usage: software sets it for each TT event it serves.

Values:
0x0 event is masked;
0x1 event is enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cel
fields.description:
Change of error level interrupt enable. Lets the raw event reach the summary flags tt_mark or tt_err of cfd_irq_raw.

Usage: software sets it for each TT event it serves.

Values:
0x0 event is masked;
0x1 event is enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txo
fields.description:
Tx count overflow interrupt enable. Lets the raw event reach the summary flags tt_mark or tt_err of cfd_irq_raw.

Usage: software sets it for each TT event it serves.

Values:
0x0 event is masked;
0x1 event is enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txu
fields.description:
Tx count underflow interrupt enable. Lets the raw event reach the summary flags tt_mark or tt_err of cfd_irq_raw.

registers.description: CAN FD safety control register. Switches the safety mechanisms on and holds the configuration unlock key.

fields.name: lock_en
fields.description:
Configuration lock. When set, the protected registers cannot be written even in INIT until the unlock key is written (SM-04).

Usage: software sets it after the configuration is done; a write with the right unlock_key clears it.

Values:
0x0 only INIT and CCE protect the registers;
0x1 the key is needed in addition.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.description:
Register parity check enable. Each configuration register is checked against its parity bit (SM-03).

0x0 no check;
0x1 parity checked on every use.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: clk_chk_en
fields.description:
Clock monitor enable. Each clock domain checks the activity of the other (SM-05).

Usage: software sets it after cfd_saf_clk and cfd_saf_clk2 are programmed.

Values:
0x0 no check;
0x1 clock monitor on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: cnt_chk_en
fields.description:
Counter compare enable. The duplicate bit timing counters and error counters are compared with the main counters (SM-06).

Usage: software sets it after the configuration is done.

Values:
0x0 no compare;
0x1 compare on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: e2e_chk_en
fields.description:
Payload signature check enable. The data path signatures are compared (SM-08).

Usage: software sets it after the configuration is done.

Values:
0x0 no check;
0x1 check on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: ram_chk_en
fields.description:
RAM error evaluation enable. The error inputs of the message RAM are evaluated (SM-01).

0x0 the error inputs are ignored;
0x1 the error inputs are evaluated.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: fsm_chk_en
fields.description:
Frame state compare enable. The duplicate frame state of the frame engine is compared with the main state (SM-07).

Usage: software sets it after the configuration is done; it needs saf_fsm of cfd_feat0.

Values:
0x0 no compare;
0x1 compare on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: txc_chk_en
fields.description:
Tx key cache parity enable. The parity of each Tx key cache entry is checked at every scan (SM-12).

Usage: software sets it after the configuration is done; it needs saf_txc of cfd_feat0.

Values:
0x0 no check;
0x1 check on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.description:

Values:
0x0 no check;
0x1 check on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

0x1 watchdog on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

fields.name: dup_chk_en
fields.description:

Values:
0x0 no compare;
0x1 compare on.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

Limits: none.

0x0 no check;

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

0x0000 to 0xFFFF other values keep the lock.

registers.name: cfd_saf_rct
registers.description: CAN FD safety reaction register. Chooses for each safety fault whether the controller stops or only reports it.

fields.name: r_ram_cor
fields.description:
Reaction to the flag ram_cor of cfd_saf_sts. Selects the safe-state reaction of the controller when this fault is detected.

Usage: software writes it in the configuration state; the reset value is stop for the faults that can corrupt a message and report only for the others.

Values:
0x0 report only: set the flag, raise o_saf_err and the interrupt, keep running;
0x1 stop: in addition set INIT and keep o_can_tx recessive (the safe state, software restarts).

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_saf_auto
registers.description: CAN FD safety automatic enable register. Shows which mechanisms the build enables from the reset.

fields.name: auto_ram
fields.description:
Automatic enable of the mechanism SM-01. Shows whether the build sets the mechanism on from the reset (bit 0 of PARA_CANFD_SAF_AUTO_MASK).

Usage: read by the driver to know which mechanisms already run; clear them with auto_off of cfd_saf_ctrl.

Values:
0x0 the mechanism starts off and software enables it;
0x1 the mechanism runs from the reset.

Unit: none.

Limits: none.

registers.name: cfd_saf_adr
registers.description: CAN FD safety RAM address register. Shows the address of the last message RAM access with an error.

fields.name: err_addr
fields.description:
Failing message RAM address. The word address of the last access that had a corrected or uncorrectable error or a timeout.

Usage: software reads it after it has seen a RAM safety flag, to find the failing element.

Values:
0x0000 to 0x3FFF word address.

Unit: words.

Limits: It is valid while a RAM flag of cfd_saf_sts is set..
